SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I, Special Branch
REPORT
Date August 24, 1936
Subject Newspaper reports alleging that ronins had coerced proprietors
of cigarette shops to purchase an article.
Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by [Signature]

On August 17, 1936, the Social Daily News (社會日報),
with an office on Ningpo Road, published an article alleging
that ronins had coerced proprietors of cigarette shops to
purchase an article supplied by them under pain of being
accused of "resisting xx and boycotting xx goods."
Discreet enquiries at various cigarette shops show
that the article in question is the "Rohto" Eye Water,
manufactured by the Yamada Pharmaceutical Company, Osaka, Japan.
Proprietors of the shops, when approached, admitted that
about two months ago, three persons - two Chinese and one
Japanese - visited their shops and requested them to act as
sales agents for this medicine. The majority of the proprietors
showed reluctance to accept the offer but the callers insisted
upon leaving about one dozen bottles of this medicine at each
shop in case some persons might desire to purchase it. As far
as can be ascertained, no threats were used by the callers to
enforce their request.
The only sales agency for the "Rohto" Eye Water is the
Toa Company, Ltd., Shanghai, 339 Honan Road, and it is sold
at 22 cents per bottle.

Sih Tse Liang
D. I.

D.C. (Crime & Special Branches)

[Stamp: DEPUTY COMMISSIONER (CRIME BRANCH)]

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别情报科（S.I. Special Branch）
报告
日期：1936年8月24日
事由：报纸报道指称浪人胁迫香烟店店主购买某商品。
呈报人：督察 施子良（Sih Tse-liang） 转呈人 [签名]

1936年8月17日，办公地点位于宁波路的《社会日报》刊登一篇文章，指称浪人以被指控“抵制xx及拒买xx货”相威胁，胁迫香烟店店主购买由其提供的某种商品。
经对各香烟店进行 discreet enquiries（谨慎查访），显示该商品为日本大阪山田制药厂生产的“乐敦”（Rohto）眼药水。
受访的店主承认，约两个月前，有三个人——两名中国人和一名日本人——光顾他们的店铺，要求他们担任该药品的销售代理。大多数店主表示不愿接受此提议，但来访者坚持在每个店铺留下约一打该药品，以备有人欲购买。据查，来访者并未使用任何威胁手段来强制其要求。
“乐敦”眼药水的唯一销售代理机构是位于河南路339号的东亚公司（Toa Company, Ltd., Shanghai），售价为每瓶22分。

施子良
督察

副 commissioner（刑事与特别情报科）

[印章：副警务处长（刑事科）]

August 17, 1936. Morning Translation.

Sin Wan Pao publishes the following letter written by one
Chin Pao Tan (金寶談) :-

CIGARETTE SHOPS COMPELLED BY RONINS TO UNDERTAKE SALE OF
AN EYE REMEDY

A man of a certain nation, speaking fluent
Mandarin, has been visiting local cigarette shops to compel
them to act as agents for the sale of a kind of liquid
medicine for the cure of sore eyes. This is intolerable.
Our Government has already incurred huge losses
owing to smuggling and this liquid medicine may be smuggled
goods too. It is to be feared that this medicine may be
harmful to eyes.
It is said that several shops have been
compelled to act as agents for the sale of the liquid
medicine, failing which they would have to visit the
Consulate of a certain nation. Chinese people should
refrain from buying this medicine. Our Government is not
powerful enough to deal with this Consulate, but we can
refuse to buy this eye medicine.
I advise all brethren to use native products.

Social Daily News (社會日報) published the following comment
on August 15 :-

The other day our reporter visited some thirty
cigarette shops and obtained the following information :-
Owing to the strict measures adopted against
dealing in smuggled goods, local cigarette shops have to
exercise great care when buying sundry goods. Well-organized
ronins have asked cigarette shops to act as agents for
the sale of their goods. As some cigarette shops agreed
to take up the business, the ronins became very active and
began to insist that every shop should sell their shops.
Should a shop refuse to sell the goods, the
ronins would visit the shop again on the following day
and compel the shop to accept the business. If the shops
again refuse, they would be accused of resisting XX and
boycotting XX goods. The ronins would say: "Beware.
If you reject the offer, action will be taken against you.
We will not allow you to do any business in future". Most
of the owners of cigarette shops are timid and had to
accept the offer.
Compulsion of Chinese people to deal in XX
goods is much prevalent in Kiangsu and Chekiang. Both
our Government and our people should find a remedy. We
must refrain from buying such goods.

1936年8月17日。晨间译文。

《新晚报》刊登了一封由金宝谈（Chin Pao Tan）撰写的来信：-

香烟店被浪人强迫代销眼药水

某国一名男子，能说流利的国语，一直走访本地香烟店，强迫他们充当一种治疗眼疾液体药品的销售代理。这令人无法容忍。
我国政府已因走私遭受巨大损失，而这种液体药品也可能是走私货物。恐怕这种药品会对眼睛有害。
据说有几家店铺已被迫充当该液体药品的销售代理，否则就必须前往某国领事馆。中国人应避免购买这种药品。我国政府无力对付该领事馆，但我们可以拒绝购买这种眼药水。
我建议各位同胞使用国货。

《社会日报》于8月15日发表如下评论：-

日前，本报记者走访了约三十家香烟店，获得以下信息：-
由于采取了严厉措施打击走私货物交易，本地香烟店在购买杂货时必须格外小心。组织严密的浪人要求香烟店充当其货物的销售代理。由于一些香烟店同意承接此项业务，浪人变得非常活跃，并开始坚持每家店铺都应销售他们的货物。
如果一家店铺拒绝销售这些货物，浪人会在第二天再次光顾该店，强迫店铺接受此项业务。如果店铺再次拒绝，他们将被指控抵制XX及拒买XX货。浪人会说：“当心。如果你拒绝此提议，将对你采取行动。我们将不允许你将来做任何生意”。大多数香烟店店主生性胆小，不得不接受此提议。
强迫中国人交易XX货的现象在江苏和浙江十分普遍。我国政府和人民都应找到补救办法。我们必须避免购买此类货物。
